summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Evidence: the security baseline covers 59 managed sites, but fleet-doctor has no run or control results, operations deploy-health/uptime/error sweeps have no results, and all security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are therefore unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are not security findings. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but that does not establish complete TLS safety. Exact decision: keep security-sensitive public exposure and releases blocked; permit only ordinary reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior, while continuing the existing read-only evidence matrix. Do not access credentials or private containers, alter permissions/configuration, deploy, add dependencies, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Security supports containment and existing evidence work only. Reject new control-plane, growth, dependency, deployment, telemetry, credential, permission, and monetization changes this cycle because material release and runtime controls remain unevidenced. Preserve the existing private launch gate and do not treat missing telemetry as a clean result.
